opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access/research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations working with disability, especially projects focused on training, employment and supported housing, helping people live more independently. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focused on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities operating sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open and accessible to the public, listed at Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument (or equivalents in Scotland/NI).
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to hospices and palliative care organisations that provide excellent care to patients and families, for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities operating libraries and archives with nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities operating museums and galleries, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to museums and galleries to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities operating performing arts organisations focused on professional performance, able to make a case for the significance of their education work within the sector.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to performing arts organisations to improve training and education facilities, generally for building or refurbishment of these facilities and occasionally related specialist equipment. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities, local authorities or universities in the UK with significant scientific or natural history collections, displaying collections of national significance and (if applicable) fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Maximum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment); £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK, with at least two years of exam results, overall 'Good' or above inspection outcome, and demonstrating excellence or significant progress towards excellence.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts). 2026 round closed; next round dates expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects that help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living after school/college. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.
